paras: Goggia braacki, also known commonly as  Braack's dwarf leaf-toed gecko, Braack's pygmy gecko, and the Karoo leaf-toed gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to South Africa.
The specific name, braacki, is in honor of South African herpetologist Harold H. Braack.
The preferred natural habitat of G. braacki is rocky areas of montane grassland.
Adults of G. braacki have a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 2.7–3.5 cm (1.1–1.4 in).
